subject: literacy
concept: Identifying an author's purpose: to inform, to entertain, or to persuade
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts short passage samples into 'inform,' 'entertain,' or 'persuade' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a passage's purpose to a pictured icon representing that purpose
exercise.abstract: Student states an author's likely purpose for a given passage and why

misconception_flags: confuses an entertaining informational text with a purely fictional/entertaining one

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
